        self.nxt = [0] * (2 * M)
        self.ep = [0] * (2 * M)
        self.cap = [0] * (2 * M)
        self.flo = [0] * (2 * M)
        self.cost = [0] * (2 * M)
        self.m = 0

    def add_edge(self, a, b, cap=1, cost=0):
        # forward edge
        self.nxt[self.m] = self.first[a]

        self.ep[self.m] = b

        self.m += 1
        # backward edge

        self.first[b] = self.m
        self.ep[self.m] = a
        self.cap[self.m] = 0
        self.flo[self.m] = 0
        self.cost[self.m] = -cost
        self.m += 1

                        self.pot[v] = self.pot[u] + self.cost[e]
                        updated = True
            if not updated:

    def mcf_update(self, s, t):
        dist = [INF] * self.N

            vis[u] = True

            if dist[i] < INF:

        return df
